coreIdea: In the final seconds of each BTC 15m episode, rest one maker bid on the near-certain winning token at a fixed sub-fair price to collect measured panic-dump flow from holders of ~99% winners, holding any fill to settlement.

experiments.hypothesis: A one-shot maker bid at ~0.965 on the near-certain favorite in the final seconds collects panic-dump fills whose realized win rate stays above the bid price, so the measured +2.3/+2.5c standing margin survives the engine's adverse-selection fill model.
experiments.successCriteria: Best cell netEvPerMarket > 0 at stage-1 coverage (STAGE-GATES.md gate 1).

passes.note: Monotone purity gain with later entry: 885 net -0.03/mkt (21 played, 19W-2L, 90.48% win), 890 net -0.03 (14 played, 12W-2L, 85.71%) - both below the 96.5% fill breakeven, both caught the same two informed-flip episodes (btc-updown-15m-1780785900, -1780893900) at -19.30 each; 895 and 897 tie at net +0.01 (8 played, 8W-0L, 100% win, all maker, zero fees) and neither filled either flip episode. 897 chosen: deepest measured checkpoint, 895 identical (stable late plateau). Advisories: thin fills (8/1000 markets) - capacity-bounded as proposed; one taker leak at 885/890 (mkt 1781227800: ask moved onto price between trigger and flush). Runs 380/369/381/382.

Deeper is better on identical fills: 0.955 net +0.01/mkt (pnl +7.20, 8 played, 8W-0L, avgWin 0.90), 0.965 net +0.01 (pnl +5.60, same 8 episodes, avgWin 0.70; exact reproduction of run 382 = determinism check), 0.975 net 0.00 (pnl +3.00, only 6 played - maker-only guard binds more when ask sits <=0.975 at t=897, and per-fill margin halves to 0.50). Under worst_queue a fill means the ask crashed through the level, so 0.955 collects strictly more margin per fill with no extra losses in this window. All cells 100% win, zero fees, zero taker. Advisory: still thin (6-8 fills/1000). Runs 383/384/385.

0.93 and 0.95 tie exactly (net +0.01/mkt, pnl +7.20, 8 played, 8W-0L, avgWin 0.90; 0.95 reproduces run 383) - the threshold does not bind between them, every filling episode already had favBid >= 0.95 at trigger. 0.97 binds hard (4 played, pnl +3.60, net 0.00) and buys no purity: all fills win at every threshold, so it only halves collection. Best 0.95 = keep the measured-band conditioning at zero participation cost; flat below, costly above. Runs 386/387/388.

Perfectly linear: same 8 episodes fill at every size, pnl scales exactly 2x per doubling (size 10 pnl +3.60/avgWin 0.45, 20 +7.20/0.90, 40 +14.40/1.80; net 0.00/+0.01/+0.01 per mkt), all 8W-0L, zero fees. 40 chosen: strictly more EV, still well inside measured $600-700/window top-3 bid depth. Caveat: the engine does not consume book depth, so linearity beyond the sweep is unverified - capacity remains bounded by the measured census depth, not by this sweep. Runs 389/390/391.

gateLog.note: Best cell (run 391: entryTimeSec=897, bidPrice=0.955, certaintyThreshold=0.95, size=40) net +0.01/mkt at 1000 markets, pnl +14.40, 8 trades, 8W-0L (100% win vs 95.5% fill breakeven), all maker, zero fees. Advisories: EV rides on 8 fills in 1000 markets (thin, capacity-bounded by design); losses appear only at earlier entries (885/890: win% 90.5/85.7, below breakeven) so the surviving edge is timing-pure; 100% win on n=8 cannot yet distinguish P(win|fill)=0.955 from >0.99 - the stage-2 extension is the discriminating test.
